sections.text: An address is unused when no relay accepted a message from it since 2025-10-07 08:32 UTC (400 days, mail_relay_unused_days). The logs of each relay must go back that far.
sections.title: How far back the logs go

sections.text: Last mail: the newest message any relay accepted from it (or from an address inside the subnet). Connections: how often it connected (a monitor or a scanner connects and sends nothing - that does not count as sending).
sections.title: Each address on the list

lines: The logs do not go back 400 days on relay1, relay2: relay1 back to 2026-04-25 (200 days); relay2 back to 2026-04-25 (200 days). An address may have sent mail before that and be called unused. Keep the mail logs longer (logrotate: /etc/logrotate.d/syslog), or set mail_relay_unused_days to what they cover.
sections.title: Note

subtitle: Nothing was changed and nothing waits for approval: the mail logs do not go back 400 days on every relay (How far back the logs go), so a quiet address cannot be told from an unused one.
title: Mail relay whitelist - unused addresses: logs too short to tell
